fields.fld9r6n3YXyXDB7Sb: Slayman Abou-Hamdan is a registered psychologist, executive coach, and former Australian Army officer working at the intersection of emotional intelligence, leadership, and human performance in the Age of AI. Supporting leaders, managers, and high-performing professionals who operate under pressure, Slayman integrates neuroscience, trauma-informed psychology, embodied awareness, and real-world leadership experience to help people stay decisive and grounded in volatile environments. His work focuses on strengthening clarity, emotional regulation, and adaptive leadership in a world shaped by rapid technological change. Through executive coaching, leadership development, and writing, Slayman equips individuals and organisations with practical frameworks that enhance performance without sacrificing humanity. Based in Melbourne, he works locally and internationally with professionals navigating complexity, uncertainty, and digital disruption.

Dr. Shyam Barr is a consultant, coach, and speaker who specialises in education, with a focus on metacognition and self-regulated learning. He has 17 years of professional experience in the education sector, working as a teacher, leader, researcher, and advisor in various contexts and settings, both nationally and internationally.

He is also a Professional Associate (previously Assistant Professor of Learning Sciences) at the University of Canberra, where he conducts and disseminates research on professional learning approaches that support teachers' thinking and practice about self-regulated learning. He holds a PhD in Cognitive Psychology and Educational Practice, a Certificate in Executive Coaching, and a Leaders of Learning credential. He has won several awards and recognition for his research, teaching, and engagement, and has published his work through various channels, including books, journals, podcasts, and blogs. His mission is to help educators foster students' self-regulated learning, and to empower young people to bring about their preferred future.

fields.fld9r6n3YXyXDB7Sb: Dominick Quartuccio's passion is helping people design a future they can't wait to live in. He once had it all - a so-called successful life and lucrative 15-year career in financial services, running sales teams in Fortune 100 companies. He led "a good life." The result? He was bored, restless and uninspired. So he left the corporate world and became a human guinea pig, subjecting himself to experiments and experiences that challenged him to assess his long-held beliefs and stories. Gradually, his behavior changed, and his life changed - for the better. Dominick is now a mentor, speaker, trainer and author dedicated to supporting others to be better versions of themselves. He helps successful, stressed and incredibly busy professionals take command of their habits - time, energy, focus and execution - so they can raise their performance in business and all aspects of their day-to-day lives. When he's not writing, speaking or coaching, he can be found devouring books, meditating, doing a push-up challenge or on an airplane (sometimes where he does all of these things).
